parts.text: Chalcopyrite, FeCuS 2 , is used in the manufacture of sulfuric acid in the Contact process.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) In the first stage of the process, chalcopyrite reacts with oxygen in the air to produce sulfur dioxide, SO 2 , iron( III ) oxide and copper( II ) oxide. parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Sulfur dioxide is then converted to sulfur trioxide. 2SO 2 + O 2 2SO 3 The reaction is exothermic. It is also an equilibrium.

ms.label: 4(b)(i)
